Class NetworkMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.utils.message.NetworkMessage
public class NetworkMessage extends Object
Single message unit exchanged over the TCP socket. Wire format: one JSON object per line, terminated by '\n'. Example: {"type":"PLACE_TOTEM","payload":{"nickname":"Alice","letter":"B"}} Typed accessors (str, num, bool, strList, mapList) avoid raw casts at every call site.
